cases.title: GAPS · guitar performance 019
cases.description: Four aligned 20-second guitar conditions: original GAPS recording, Flat 64, 5 s Diff-Synth, and 5 s Diff-SFProxy.
cases.provenance: GAPS test piece 019_Vpswc from the 5090 HDF5 cache. Diff-Synth and Diff-SFProxy were rerun on its aligned score using adapted 5 s guitar VeloEst checkpoints recovered from the 5090 /storage HDD archives (60k and 120k iterations respectively). The original archived Diff-Synth prediction omits seven score notes across these two windows, so this demo uses a complete rerun from its recovered checkpoint. The score has no ground-truth guitar velocities, so no guitar MAE is shown. Both renders use FreePats Spanish Classical Guitar SFZ.

cases.title: François Leduc · guitar performance JGDyc
cases.description: Four aligned 20-second guitar conditions from the same François Leduc performance, with 5 s adapted models.
cases.provenance: Original François Leduc recording and score from the 5090 HDF5 cache. Diff-Synth is the saved 5 s, 60k prediction MIDI from the 5090 /storage archive; its full-dataset r_BSSL 0.645489 agrees with the paper’s rounded 0.646. Diff-SFProxy was rerun from the recovered 5 s, 120k guitar VeloEst checkpoint. The score has no ground-truth guitar velocities, so no guitar MAE is shown. Both renders use FreePats Spanish Classical Guitar SFZ.

cases.title: Scriabin, Entragete · 2009 performance
cases.description: One matched 20-second piano excerpt with the original performance, a constant-velocity control, and both saved adaptation methods.
cases.provenance: MAE badges cover the full 164.7-second, 721-note piece; audio and MIDI show only 60–80 s. Diff-Synth is a saved 5 s, 60k run. Diff-SFProxy was rerun from the released piano 5 s, 120k checkpoint. This single-piece example is separate from the paper aggregates.

cases.title: Scriabin, Entragete · 2009 performance
cases.description: A second 20-second passage from the same MAESTRO performance, with all four aligned listening conditions.
cases.provenance: MAE badges are computed over this 20-second, 117-note passage. Diff-Synth is a saved 5 s, 60k run; Diff-SFProxy uses the released piano 5 s, 120k checkpoint. These case values are separate from the full-piece example and paper aggregates.

cases.title: Bach BWV 849 · SMD piano performance
cases.description: A real 20-second Disklavier recording with both saved 5 s adaptation predictions on the same aligned notes.
cases.provenance: MAE badges are computed over the selected 20 seconds (113 score notes), not the full SMD piece or the paper aggregate. Diff-Synth is the saved 5 s, 60k sup0/backend1 run; Diff-SFProxy is the saved 5 s, 120k smooth-L1 run. All renders use Salamander Grand Piano V3.

cases.title: Bach BWV 849 · SMD piano performance
cases.description: A second 20-second SMD window with the same four aligned listening conditions.
cases.provenance: MAE badges are computed over this 20-second excerpt (108 score notes). The saved 5 s Diff-Synth and Diff-SFProxy predictions are demonstration runs, not a claim that these are the exact Table 2 aggregate checkpoints.
